notes:
- Your agent can answer out loud in one of three Google voices: Kore, Sulafat or Puck. On the
  Personality tab, press Change voice under Speaking voice and look under Google voices. Google makes
  each answer on your own Gemini key, so the words it speaks go to Google. If your agent has no
  Gemini key yet, paste one right there.
- On a Mac with Apple's own chip, your agent can speak in Aiden or Sarah, two livelier voices
  made right on the Mac, under Voices made on this Mac. They take a 1.8 GB download, and nothing is
  sent anywhere to make them. The talk screen speaks in Heart for now, whichever voice you pick.
- The voice list keeps the 16 voices that sound best. An agent already using one of the others
  keeps it, and an agent that never picked a voice now speaks in Heart.
- Amounts are said the right way round: "$340" is said "340 dollars".
- On a Mac with Text Replies, ask your agent about a text conversation and it reads that
  conversation in Messages first: both sides, each message under the name of whoever sent it.
- With phone access on, a Mac on its charger stays awake so your phone can reach it, even with
  the lid shut. On battery it sleeps as it always did. A Mac that is asleep now shows as asleep on
  Archie Mobile, instead of looking awake and never answering.
- When a chat app won't take a file, a short text file arrives in the chat as its text.
- Fixed: files your agent sent in Slack never arrived.
- Fixed: when going back to the version you had before an update could not finish, the saved copy
  of your agents could be lost.
- Fixed: Likely scams and Text Replies could warn about a customer's own gift card order, or a new
  number asking you for an invoice.
